title: Sahidic Coptic Old Testament (Göttingen / CoptOT basetext via Coptic SCRIPTORIUM)
attribution: Coptic SCRIPTORIUM; Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities / CoptOT; licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
notes: Supplementary Sahidic OT parallel corpus (~18,400 verses) with full TreeTagger SGML annotations (orig_group, norm_group, norm, lemma, pos, morph, lang, multiword). Paired with Swete LXX and used to train Coptic morphological segmentation/POS/lemmatization for Horner NT without touching Wells Sahidica. ShareAlike applies to derived adaptations.
